Callout.Name: Armed Robbery at a Takeaway
Callout.Message: Armed robbery at a takeaway, staff locked in the back.
Callout.Advisory: One suspect, weapon seen, staff unhurt.

Script.Line: There are two staff locked in the back and they will not come out.
He went out the side door two minutes ago.
He took the till. The till is gone, the staff are not.

Lines.Approach: One suspect with a weapon and the staff are in the back room with the door shut.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
